title: SBI Overtakes ICICI Bank as India's 2nd Largest Lender by Market Capitalisation
summary: SBI's market cap reached ₹9.60 trillion in Q4 FY26, reclaiming the #2 position in m-cap behind HDFC Bank (₹12.27 trillion).

blocks.title: 📰 3. 🏦 BANKING & INSURANCE NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 SBI Overtakes ICICI Bank as India's 2nd Largest Lender by Market Capitalisation. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: According to S&P Global Market Intelligence data, **State Bank of India (SBI)** surpassed ICICI Bank in market capitalisation for the first time since August 2019.
**Top 3 Lenders by M-Cap**: 1. HDFC Bank (₹12.27T) | 2. SBI (₹9.60T / ₹9,60,815 Cr) | 3. ICICI Bank (₹9.17T / ₹9,17,201 Cr).
**Balance Sheet Goal**: SBI announced plans to expand its balance sheet to **25% of India's GDP by 2030** (from ~20% currently, standing at ₹71.62 lakh crore).
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on institutional financial products, interest margins, capital adequacy ratios, and digital payment infrastructure.
